blurb: A "Sightseeing Show on Wheels" aboard a one-of-a-kind trolley with a trio of professional entertainers! Travel through time in this classic trolley as you ride through the historical districts of Salt Lake City. The Salt Lake Trolley is fun for ALL ages. Your charming Conductor, his attractive Assistant, and a magical Motorman will entertain you with dozens of tales in a theatrical fashion. This is unlike any tour you've seen before...it's a "Sightseeing Show" you'll never forget!
